glosses: to calm down, to quiet down

examples.text: В су́мерки това́рищ Коротко́в, си́дя на ба́йковой крова́ти, вы́пил три буты́лки вина́, что́бы всё забы́ть и успоко́иться.
examples.translation: In the twilight Korotkov sat in his flannelette bed and drank three bottles of wine to forget everything and calm down.
examples.english: In the twilight Korotkov sat in his flannelette bed and drank three bottles of wine to forget everything and calm down.

glosses: To become less excited, intense, or angry.

examples.text: Calm down before you hurt somebody.

glosses: To cause to become less excited, intense, or angry.

examples.text: As the lights dimmed the general noise quieted down.

glosses: To make someone or something become quieter.

examples.text: The teacher did her best to quiet the children down.
Diplomacy can only begin when the violence quiets down.

glosses: To make or become quiet and calm after a period of disturbance or restlessness.

examples.text: It took John a while to settle down after the phone call.
In terms of passenger route mileage, the UK railway of early 1970 had settled down to close to the present level, although there was still some pruning to do.

It is never possible to settle down to the ordinary routine of life at sea until the screw begins to revolve. There is an hour or two, after the passengers have embarked, which is disquieting and fussy.

glosses: To establish a settled lifestyle for oneself, especially by marrying.
To grow comfortable and familiar with one's new accommodation or circumstances.

examples.text: I have not yet settled down in my new apartment.

glosses: Recuperar la calma, el control sobre los nervios y el estado de ánimo.

examples.text: i due si calmarono troppo tardi dopo la lite furiosa
"Aspetta che mi calmi, scusami"

glosses: procurare o procurarsi un po' di distensione emotiva

examples.text: Ancora incredulo, il ragazzo seriosamente: "Si calmi, Signora... Vado subito a comprare il gelato per tutti qui!"

glosses: riferimento alla mancanza di tempeste, burrasche... soprattutto in mare

examples.text: La mer se calme.
Le tumulte s’est calmé.
Calmez-vous !
La douleur commence à se calmer.
Sers-moi un verre de chartreuse… j'ai le cœur sens dessus dessous… ça me remettra… de la verte, tu sais… la jaune est trop fade.
– Remettez-vous, cher ami : je partagerai de bon cœur vos tribulations et déboires comme vos béatitudes et aubaines.

examples.translation: Czy możesz się uspokoić? Nie jesteś już dzieckiem.

examples.text: Спаси́бо, зубна́я боль уже́ успоко́илась
Вью́га успоко́илась. Ду́маю, мо́жем идти́ гуля́ть.
